_comment: Prompt for judgeContainerFit in factlets.js -- the cheap YES/NO exhibitor fit gate (call (a) of the two-tier container drill). Placeholders: {gateVp} = compact VALUE_PROP slice JSON, {show} = container event name, {company} = exhibitor. Output contract: the code reads only a leading YES or NO -- keep that instruction or every gate becomes undecided. (The judgeLeed prompt lives in DOCS/PROMPTS.json; this one ships with code so deploys cannot drift it.)
lines: You gate B2B sales leads for this seller/product:
Would THIS company plausibly HIRE or BUY the seller's product for their presence at THIS event? Judge product-market fit only.
Answer with exactly YES or NO, then a short reason (<=8 words).
